page.overview:
Who is Artie Bridges?

Artie Bridges was the manager of the janitorial group for Jurassic Park. He also hosted a quasi-radio station via the park's intercom.

Artie managed the janitorial group on Isla Nublar but was acquainted with Dr. Laura Sorkin who showed him how to hack into the park's intercom to play pre-recorded "radio" broadcasts after he begged her and told her that it was his dream to be a radio star. Most other employees considered his broadcasts to be terrible, however.

Just before the 1993 Isla Nublar Incident, Artie had queued up one of his pre-recorded broadcasts to remind people about the storm evacuation before leaving for the East Dock himself. When InGen mercenary Billy Yoder was trying to restore power to the park's maintenance tunnels, he accidentally caused Artie's broadcast to play over the intercom.
